cond_0001.intro: The Sr. Quality Engineer analyzes manufacturing processes for improvement, using various methods of testing and inspection. Develop, apply and maintain quality requirements for the launching of new products. Promote and execute quality standards, inspection processes, test methodology, quality plans, documents and reports.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Basic Responsibilities:
Provide guidance and direction to quality personnel as required
Manage PPAP Documentation
Put together full PPAP packages and submit to the customer
Update/Modify Process Flow Diagrams
Update/Modify PFMEAs
Update/Modify In Process Inspection sheets (IPI)
Order gaging for new parts per Control Plans
When applicable log and Maintain material certs into record system
Correct previous doc control systems / locating updating missing documents
Ballooning drawings
Performs numerous other duties as required pertaining to quality
Written and verbal communication with the Customers, as required
When applicable participate in continues improvements process
Follow safety procedures
Follow Company policies
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a quality engineering role in a manufacturing environment.
Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality management, or a related field.
Strong understanding of quality control principles and methodologies, such as Six Sigma and lean manufacturing.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Requirements
Proven ability to identify and resolve quality issues effectively.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills.
Proficient in quality control software and statistical analysis tools.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Promote and execute quality standards, inspection processes, test methodology, quality plans, documents and reports.
cond_0138.responsibilities:
Basic Responsibilities:
Provide guidance and direction to quality personnel as required
Manage PPAP Documentation
Put together full PPAP packages and submit to the customer
Update/Modify Process Flow Diagrams
Update/Modify PFMEAs
Update/Modify In Process Inspection sheets (IPI)
Order gaging for new parts per Control Plans
When applicable log and Maintain material certs into record system
Correct previous doc control systems / locating updating missing documents
Ballooning drawings
Performs numerous other duties as required pertaining to quality
Written and verbal communication with the Customers, as required
When applicable participate in continues improvements process
Follow safety procedures
Follow Company policies
cond_0138.requirements:
Around 5 years of experience in a quality engineering role in a manufacturing environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of quality control principles and methodologies, such as Six Sigma and lean manufacturing.
Experience identifying and resolving quality issues.
Ability to analyze problems and work through solutions methodically.
Ability to communicate effectively and work well with others as part of a team.
Familiarity with quality control software and statistical analysis tools.
Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Promote and execute quality standards, inspection processes, test methodology, quality plans, documents and reports.

Provide guidance and direction to quality personnel as required
Manage PPAP Documentation
Put together full PPAP packages and submit to the customer
Update/Modify Process Flow Diagrams
Update/Modify PFMEAs
Update/Modify In Process Inspection sheets (IPI)
Order gaging for new parts per Control Plans
When applicable log and Maintain material certs into record system
Correct previous doc control systems / locating updating missing documents
Ballooning drawings
Performs numerous other duties as required pertaining to quality
Written and verbal communication with the Customers, as required
When applicable participate in continues improvements process
Follow safety procedures
Follow Company policies
cond_0460.requirements:
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a quality engineering role in a manufacturing environment.
Strong understanding of quality control principles and methodologies, such as Six Sigma and lean manufacturing.
Proven ability to identify and resolve quality issues effectively.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills.
Proficient in quality control software and statistical analysis tools.
Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality management, or a related field.
